chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl from al-Abbas ibn Amir from Abu al-Mi'za Humayd ibn al-Muthanna from Abu al-Abbas and Ubayd ibn Ziyad from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a young boy who married a young girl, he (the Imam) said: 'They inherit from each other if their parents married them off.' I asked: 'Is the father's divorce valid?' He said: 'No.'
ai.seo_question: Do child spouses inherit from each other if their parents arranged the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the inheritance rights in child marriages (*nikah al-saghir*) arranged by parents, affirming that the spouses inherit from one another upon consummation or maturity. It specifically addresses the father's authority in dissolving the marriage, ruling that his unilateral divorce (*talaq*) is valid and sufficient, even without the child's independent consent, reflecting the Shia juristic view of the father as the natural guardian (*wali*) in such unions.
